legends.rank: Player tiers (projected longevity bin). GREEN: starter and above (bold = surefire star, italics = deep starter, underline = at least a starter). YELLOW: role player and above (bold = super role player, italics = good role player, underline = solid role player). RED: deep bench and above (bold = interesting, will get fighting chances; italics = fighting chances; underline = deep bench).
legends.name: Highlighted green = international player (or born internationally). Name in red = bust potential, or a "second wind" type whose first team won't reap the rewards. Name in green = very good potential flag (high star and glue ratings).
legends.age: Bold + underlined = high-usage player (usage 28%+); bold red = low-usage player (16% or less).
legends.info: Success marks from skill comparisons and NBA player comparisons: bold green underlined = really great success metrics; bold black underlined = good success metrics; bold red underlined = bust potential (more of a project; the second team may reap the rewards).
legends.bin: Projected value based on longevity, from skill efficacy and player comparisons in the league (bumps only for solid role players and below, under 16). The board is sorted by this bin, then by skill set.
legends.ratios: Star / glue / OK / bust ratios: the share of a player's closest skill matches (SKILL...) and NBA player comparisons (PLYR...) that became stars, glue guys, OK players or busts. Cyan / lime = very high, green = high, yellow = middling, red = low (for bust: red = high bust share).
legends.proj: Proj_Mins / Proj_WSBPM: projected NBA minutes per game and win shares + BPM from the aggregate of three machine-learning models (ExtraTrees ensembles on college or international stats, heatmaps and SOS).
